notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The Release is Near!
notes.notes:
[i]Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farwell[/i] is now in its final stages! After months of hard work, I am thrilled to announce that the game is [b]almost ready[/b] for the official release.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Feedback from Beta Testers[/h2] I had the privilege of having the game tested by a group of selected beta testers, and their feedback has helped refine every detail. The eerie atmosphere and twists that define the game have been polished to offer you an unforgettable experience.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2] The game is inspired by the legendary TV series [i]The Twilight Zone[/i]. Every puzzle, every shadow, has been designed to make you doubt what is real and what lurks in the depths of the mind.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Questions? We Are Here to Answer![/h2] Do you have any curiosities or questions about [i]Scary Shadow Spot[/i]? We are here to answer anything that comes to mind. What secrets are hidden in Mark's house? What awaits you in the darkness? We can't wait to hear your questions!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Thank You for the Support![/h2] Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release day.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Here we are, finally, at the first update of Bloody Ink!
I am really happy that you are enjoying this game and I sincerely thank you for the wonderful reviews you are leaving! I am honored.
I have taken note of the advice and criticism and, following your indications, I have made changes to improve the game. Here are the changes:

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added support for 21:9 monitors. Now it is possible to play without problems at any type of resolution.
[*] Fixed the zoom of the coat for the disguise. Now it is possible to correctly examine the object.
[*] Improved the interaction graphics with the safe. The number being modified is now highlighted, avoiding confusion.
[*] Fixed some graphic errors in the version: "The Hour of Fear".
[*] Fixed some jumpscares.
[*] Fixed typos during the examination of some signs.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

[h2]If you have a game in progress, this update will corrupt ALL save files. In the Steam settings, you can select the version of Bloody Ink you are playing to continue with your game.[/h2]
